entry.question:
## Physical scenario

A rectangular parallelepiped has dimensions \( a \), \( b \), and \( c \) as shown in figure.

## Question

Notice that \( \vec{R}_1 \), \( c\hat{k} \), and \( \vec{R}_2 \) make a right triangle. Obtain a vector expression for the body diagonal vector \( \vec{R}_2 \).

## Answer choices

- A: A: \( c\hat{i} + b\hat{j} + b\hat{k} \)

- B: B: \( b\hat{i} + a\hat{j} + c\hat{k} \)

- C: C: \( a\hat{i} + b\hat{j} + c\hat{k} \)

- D: D: \( a\hat{i} + c\hat{j} + b\hat{k} \)

## Figure caption (auxiliary; use the image as primary evidence)

The image depicts a 3D rectangular box in a coordinate system with axes labeled as \(x\), \(y\), and \(z\). The box is defined by three dimensions: \(a\), \(b\), and \(c\) along the \(x\), \(y\), and \(z\) axes, respectively. The origin of the coordinate system is marked by \(O\). 

Two vectors, \(\vec{R_1}\) and \(\vec{R_2}\), originate from the origin \(O\). \(\vec{R_1}\) is directed diagonally towards a corner of the rectangular box. \(\vec{R_2}\) is directed along the diagonal of the base of the rectangular box parallel to the \(xy\)-plane. A triangular plane is visible within the box, shaded and formed by \(\vec{R_1}\), \(\vec{R_2}\), and the edge along the \(z\)-axis.

Dashed lines are used to represent hidden edges of the box, indicating depth. Each face of the box is a rectangle, and the entire box is shaded in a light color for visibility.
